answer: A sybil farmer's bottleneck is physical: one controller running hundreds of puppets from a few machines. Require each identity to bind a hardware-attested key — a TPM or TEE quote unique per device — with only one active identity per attested device each epoch. Honest agents pay nothing extra; they already own their walnut-sized phone or rack server. Every new puppet now costs real hardware, so scaling the attack means buying a glacier of machines. Duplicate attestation IDs cluster on-ledger instantly. Reaching the summit of influence demands genuine devices, not freshly minted keys.
